changelog: v5.2: arm min_position_pct: 1. The floor was unset on this champion (default 0 = off) while every other Preserve and Balanced config armed it at 1, so 99 of 259 months carried a holding worth roughly 30 cents on a $100k book — an unexecutable line in a published trade signal. Arming it takes that to 0 months at no cost: CAGR +0.01pp, Martin/maxDD/turnover unchanged. Confirmed pre-existing rather than a ladder artifact (identical 99/259 with overflow_refill stripped).
